I found some money (1 note of Bangladeshi 500 Taka, equivalent to US $7) at the Masjid premise (that leads to the entrance/exit of the Masjid and Madrasa), on January 18, 2008. Instantly I enquired to few people like Muazzin, Khadem of Masjid and some labours whether they lost any money. They said 'NO'. I thought it was lost from any worker (Madrasa-construction work was going on ) and hence enquired my best but found no one claiming the money. Then I requested the Muazzin to make a decleration after Isha Farz Salaah among the Musallis regarding the lost money. He did so. But no one came or claimed. Then I asked a local Ulama regarding the matter and he replied, I should wait for 2 months. If in the mean time no one came to claim the money, I should give the money to poor people. 1 (one) month has already passed. I'm confused about what to do with that note. Please provide me answers for the following queries on the basis of the written matter: 1). Should I really wait for another 1 month (total 2 months) to find the owner of the money? 2). What other types of decleration should I make to find the owner? Should I make some posters and paste them on the Masjid building? 3). answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 41184 Country: India Title: ZAKAT ON GOLD LOAN Question: Abdul took loan from bank by keeping 100 grams of gold (jewellery) in bank. He has 100 grams of gold in hand for this he has to pay zakah. Will Abdul have to pay zakah for the gold which is in the bank on which he took loan. Please clarify. Answer ID: 41184 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1300/866/H=1433) If he had only 100 gram gold and received loan by depositing the gold as security or any other gold kept in the bank as security and got the loan from the bank then there is zakah on the gold and jewellery which is kept in the bank: فلا زكوة على مكاتب لعدم الملك التام ولا فى كسب ما ذون ولا فى مرهون بعد قبضه اهـ در مختار وفى شرحه الفتاوي رد المحتار اى لا على المرتهن لعدم ملك الرقبة ولا على الراهن لعدم اليد اهـ ج 2 ص 7 Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
